column2: [intro]
I’m a quirky girl, always laughing,
In my life, it’s the twists and turns
That fuel my writing, always crafting.
I want a story, bold and daring,
One that makes the crowds go wild,
Igniting smiles and keeping spirits high.
People think I’m a bit crazy,
But I don’t mind at all, really.
I’m a dash of madness in this pot,
Determined to make my mark, a lot.
Give me a story, one that thrills,
One that makes my wings unfurl,
Creating waves and applause galore.
[ solo ]
I want a story, bold and daring,
One that makes the crowds go wild,
Igniting smiles and keeping spirits high.
[outro]
I want a story, bold and daring,
One that makes my wings unfurl,
Creating waves and applause galore.
[outro]
